SSP1-L.storyline: International cooperation, resource efficiency and cleaner technologies advance early, while energy and material demand grow more slowly.
SSP1-L.pathway: Strong early mitigation; CO₂ falls rapidly, reaches net zero late in the century and becomes net negative in this IMAGE implementation.
SSP1-L.watch: Coordinated action and technology diffusion are assumptions, not observed inevitabilities.

SSP2-M.storyline: Social, economic and technological trends broadly continue along historical patterns, with uneven progress and no deep global transformation.
SSP2-M.pathway: A medium-emissions pathway in which CO₂ remains strongly positive through 2100.
SSP2-M.watch: Continuation is still a modeled choice; it is not a probability-weighted forecast.

SSP3-H.storyline: Countries prioritise security and self-sufficiency; cooperation weakens, development slows and technology diffuses less evenly.
SSP3-H.pathway: A high-emissions pathway with persistent fossil use and high late-century warming in this IMAGE implementation.
SSP3-H.watch: High is a stress-test world, not a synonym for business as usual.

SSP2-VLHO.display_name: Middle of the Road / Very Low, High Overshoot
SSP2-VLHO.storyline: The SSP2 socioeconomic storyline is retained while very deep mitigation is imposed after delay.
SSP2-VLHO.pathway: A high-overshoot pathway that reaches net-negative CO₂ and relies strongly on carbon removal to lower warming later.
SSP2-VLHO.watch: The return from overshoot depends on assumed feasibility, scale and durability of removals.
